messages:
maya: Heads-up — planning a gradual rollout for SDK v3.4 this Thursday. Canary starts 03:00 UTC, full ramp by 08:00 UTC if no regressions. Need deploy owners, smoke owners, and client-comms signoff.

eric: I can own the deploy window and watch runtime metrics. I’ll be oncall from 02:45–09:30 UTC.

julie: I’ll handle client comms — short changelog, migration notes, and a post in #announcements. Any urgent compatibility bullets?

maya: No hard breaking changes, but header name `X-User-Id` -> `X-Client-User` (optional fallback supported). Mention in changelog + migration snippet.

sam: Smoke checklist (quick):
```
1) deploy to canary bucket (5% traffic)
2) run gen sanity: curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TEST' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"model":"rwd-3.4","input":"smoke"}' | jq .status == \"ok\"
3) run perf probe: 50 requests @ p95 < 180ms
4) embedding health: sample vector dims == 1536
```
I’ll run 2) and 3) and post results here.

eric: Good — also add KV cache warmup in preflight. If p95 jumps >30% we abort.

neha: FYI CS + a handful of power customers want a heads-up email 24h before. Can we schedule that?

julie: Yep — draft ready, will send 24h prior and include rollback instructions + how to opt-out of new headers.

maya: Deploy-bot — please queue the canary job for 2028-03-14T03:00:00Z (job id optional).

deploy-bot: Scheduled deploy job queued: job_id=deploy-20280314-03-canary (queued by maya). Estimated duration: 30m.

eric: I’ll kick off Canary at 03:00 UTC, watch canary dashboards, then open a tiny rollout: 5% -> 20% -> 50% -> 100% if green. Each step wait 10m.

sam: Canary smoke done: gen sanity ok, p95 128ms, embedding dims OK. Posting logs to ops-storage/rollouts/sdk3.4/canary.log :thumbsup:

maya: Thanks — passing to julie for client comms publish. julie, confirm email schedule + changelog link?

julie: Confirmed. Email scheduled 24h before, changelog at https://docs.redwood.ai/changelog/sdk-3-4. Migration snippet included.

neha: CS noted. I’ll push a small FAQ to customers flagged as early-adopters.

eric: Rollout now at 50% (stepped up). Watching latency and error-rate. No anomalies.

sam: Running quick regression eval on saved prompts, all scores within tolerance.

maya: If anything spikes, rollback plan: revert gateway route to rwd-3.3 (automated rollback script: `scripts/rollback-sdk.sh <route>`), notify #incidents and paging list.

eric: Acknowledged. I’ll keep the window open until 09:30 UTC for any post-rollout issues.

maya: Great work team — final status: canary ✅, progressive rollout ✅, client comms ✅. Closing this thread after postmortem notes in #eng-platform later. :tada:
